data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: nurse
sections.question: nurse
sections.summary: a person trained to look after sick or injured people; also to care for someone who is ill

senses.definition: a person who is trained to look after sick or injured people, usually working in a hospital or clinic
examples: The nurse checked his temperature and gave him his medicine.
She wants to become a nurse because she enjoys helping people.

senses.definition: to look after someone who is sick or injured and help them to get better
examples: She nursed her mother back to health after the operation.
He stayed home to nurse his cold for two days.

answers.answer: The nurse checked his temperature and gave him his medicine.
He cooked a nurse for dinner and served it with vegetables.
She drove her nurse to school every morning and parked outside.
They planted a nurse in the garden and watered it every day.

sections.title: sick
sections.question: sick
sections.summary: suffering from an illness or disease; not feeling well

senses.definition: physically unwell; suffering from an illness or disease and not feeling well
examples: She felt sick all morning and could not eat her breakfast.
He stayed at home because he was too sick to go to work.
